storeSettings.returnPolicy:
All sales are final (with one exception).
For items picked up in-store, you’re welcome to try on at time of pick-up within 30 days of purchase. At that time, you can exchange for store credit if the item(s) doesn’t work for you. Once it leaves the store, all sales are final.

Mystery Bags, event tickets, and all services are final sale.
storeSettings.termsOfService: Items for in-store pick-up must be retrieved with 30 days from purchase. After 30 days, unclaimed purchased will be returned to the floor and customers will not be refunded.

items.title: Cake Website Gift Card
items.excerpt:
Website gift cards are for shopping our website only. They’re purchased and fulfilled through our site, and your gift card arrives instantly via automated email.

Website gift cards work for:
• Items in our online shop
• Mystery Bags

They do not work for:
• In-store shopping
• Instagram Story sales
• Style Sessions

If you need an in-store gift card, please call or visit our shop.
If you want a Style Session gift card, click here.

Purchase + Delivery:
Buy your website gift card here and you’ll receive an emailed gift card code. This code is what you or your recipient will use to check out on our website. No physical card will be mailed. Feel free to print or forward the email to gift it.

Gift Card Amount Increments:
If you are looking for an amount outside of the options listed here ($25, $50, $75, $100, $150, $200, $250), please get in touch!

items.title: Large Mystery Bag
items.excerpt:
Embrace the fun and adventure of thrift with a Mystery Bag! Answer some quick questions about your size + style and our team will hand pick goodies just for you.

You can expect all types of clothing and possibly accessory items in your Mystery Bag. When you check out, you can also share items you’d prefer to see or don’t want in your bag. You’ll also have an opportunity to share your shoe size if you’re interested in shoes being included. 

We’ll do our best to include what you’re looking for based on our current inventory. Please note that we’ll do our best to avoid items you’re not interested in but cannot guarantee every request.

$130 Large Mystery Bags include $130 worth of Cake inventory. Large Mystery Bags are often 5+ items that would originally retail for $250+ (MSRP).

Like everything you purchase online, Mystery Bags are available for in-store pick-up or shipping for $10. For pick up, please allow 72 hours before pick up. For shipped Mystery Bags, it can take up to 2 weeks for Mystery Bags to ship. All sales final with Mystery Bags.

items.title: Mini Mystery Bag
items.excerpt:
Introducing our choose-your-budget Mini Mystery Bags! Try out the fun and adventure of Mystery Bags with a Mini bag tailored to your budget!

Our Mystery Bags have been a client favorite for years, and we're excited to make trying them out even friendlier on your budget! Want a sprinkle of fun for spring? Need a new work look? Or just in the mood for a sweet surprise? Let us put together a Mini Mystery Bag curated just for you!

Choose your budget: $30 - $60! You can expect 2-4 items depending on the budget you choose.

When you order, you'll answer some quick questions about your size + style, and our team will handpick goodies just for you.


Here are the details:
You can expect all types of clothing and possibly accessory items in your Mystery Bag. When you check out, you can also share items you’d prefer to see or don’t want in your bag. You’ll also have an opportunity to share your shoe size if you’re interested in shoes being included. 

We’ll do our best to include what you’re looking for based on our current inventory. Please note that we’ll do our best to avoid items you’re not interested in but cannot guarantee every request.

Like everything you purchase online, Mystery Bags are available for in-store pick-up or shipping for $10. For pick up, please allow 72 hours before pick up. For shipped Mystery Bags, it can take up to 2 weeks for Mystery Bags to ship. All sales final with Mystery Bags.

The joy of Mystery Bags is truly the surprise we’re packing up for you. If you’re feeling unsure or the “mystery” feels more stressful than fun, Mystery Bags probably aren’t right for you.

See other Mystery Bag options here!
